'''Edan-Je''' was a member of the [[Voss commandos]] living on [[Voss]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He asked a Galactic Republic individual to destroy the [[Gormak cannon]] located in the [[Gormak Lands]].<ref name="TOR" />
